mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at Verona Community Park are 51 degrees under clear skies with a waxing gibbous moon. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 50 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

City crews will begin important road maintenance through crack filling on September 28 across multiple areas including South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street, while the Plan Commission prepares to review several new development projects on October 5.

We have a packed calendar starting tomorrow with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by the Verona Fall Fest taking place this September 25.
Regarding the weekly report, on September 5, officers investigated a series of reports involving vehicles with cheese placed on their windshields, a viral prank identified as the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so they will be closed for the day. Be sure to check back for tomorrow's flavor when they reopen tomorrow at 10 AM.
